newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha sharply higher but trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha sharply higher but trade quiet.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were sharply higher on Monday as talk of delayed Iraqi oil sales boosted crude and gasoline, but traders said activity was thin.
They said the market remained tight in northwest Europe and stronger gasoline prices had created some good demand for N+A material from reformers but offers of the product were scarce.

Supply in the Mediterranean for recently tight high paraffinic naphtha for September seemed to be lengthening though with Egyptian and Skikda barrels emerging, but plentiful demand ensured good support for prices, traders said.
